name: Checkbox
description: A form control that allows the user to toggle between checked, unchecked, and optionally indeterminate states. Built on @radix-ui/react-checkbox with a Check icon from lucide-react. Styled as a 16x16px rounded-sm box with primary color when checked.

props.name: checked
props.description: The controlled checked state. Can be true, false, or 'indeterminate'.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: The default checked state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Event handler called when the checked state changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the checkbox, showing cursor-not-allowed and reducing opacity to 50%.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the checkbox as required for form validation.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the checkbox for form submission.

props.name: value
props.description: The value submitted with the form when checked.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes merged via cn().

accessibility.role: Renders as a button with role='checkbox'. The native checkbox input is hidden but present for form submission.
accessibility.keyboard: Space toggles the checkbox. Tab moves focus to/from the checkbox. Focus-visible ring appears on keyboard navigation.
accessibility.aria: aria-checked reflects the current state ('true', 'false', or 'mixed' for indeterminate). Pair with a label element using htmlFor or wrap the checkbox in a label for screen reader support.
accessibility.notes: The component uses the 'peer' class, enabling peer-based styling on sibling elements (e.g., peer-disabled:cursor-not-allowed on an adjacent label).
